proposition: What does a geometric-mean reporting comment require for comparison of individual monitoring-period values?
would_establish: Permit footnote *6 requires reporting the geometric mean of weekly TDS discharge values at Outfall 001, not a raw single sample.
TDS net-increase enforceable limits use a 30-day average statistic per statement of basis, distinct from the weekly geometric-mean reporting language in footnote *6.

The DMR_COMMENT_TEXT is TDS-specific but is mechanically propagated to all rows in limit set 3600645646 schedule 3600891019, so non-TDS parameters inherit comment text without parameter-specific semantic effect.
Structured STATISTICAL_BASE_TYPE_CODE on all 40 rows remains AVG, MAX, or MIN; none encodes geometric mean as the comparison basis.
DMR measurements store one value per MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE (monthly), while many paired limits show weekly sampling frequency (05/WK or 01/07).
would_refute: A uniform rule that every row with this comment forbids direct single-period numeric comparison to its paired limit.
A uniform rule that geometric mean is always the enforcement statistic wherever the comment appears.
Treating aztec/gcc document mentions of geometric mean as grounding for this Farmington limit-set comment trigger.
insufficient_alone: PRIOR_PACKET.json (bounded prior retrieval, not authoritative disposition)
Structured DMR rows without weekly sub-sample values (cannot verify pre-aggregation)
Permit documents for aztec and gcc (unrelated geometric-mean contexts)
